newsitem.title: USA: AudioFAX sues DeltaTel over fax patent.
newsitem.headline: AudioFAX sues DeltaTel over fax patent.

text.p: AudioFAX IP LLC said on Wednesday that it has filed a patent infringement suit seeking an immediate injunction prohibiting DeltaTel Inc from continuing to offer fax mailbox services to its customers.
DeltaTel is a wholly owned subsidiary of Delta Air Lines. Officials at DeltaTel were not available for comment.
Additionally, AudioFAX is seeking treble damages for past alleged infringement of the fax patents owned by AudioFAX.

DeltaTel's infringing activity allegedly stems from its promotion, marketing, and sales of its branded version of the WORLDLINK Communications Card, provided through Premiere Technologies, AudioFAX said.
Premiere, which provides the service to DeltaTel, was sued by AudioFAX for patent infringement on July 2, 1996.

AudioFAX stated that it had recently notified 10 other Premiere Technologies distributors and co-marketers of the WORLDLINK card to cease and desist providing services that allegedly infringe the patents by November 1, 1996.
